blocks.text: Jane Roe is a painter and textile artist based in Eastmoor. She was born in 1986 in Westfield and trained first as a textile designer, then as a painter, finishing her MFA at the Eastmoor School of Art in 2016. Since then she has shown in museums, artist-run spaces and textile fairs, and held a studio fellowship at the Riverside Art Institute. She teaches in the textile department part-time.

Roe's work moves between paint and cloth. Her paintings follow one stretch of shore through the year, and her weavings record the weather of a single day in rows of dyed wool. Both come from long, repeated routines: the same walk, the same loom, the same palette mixed again. She is interested in how a routine turns into a record, and how a record can be read by someone else.
